page: Microsoft Azure D96_v5 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the Dv5 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The hardware configuration features 96 virtual CPUs mapped to 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing two threads per core. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong multi-core capabilities alongside average single-core performance. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the average category, but the multi-core metrics are strong, with a multi-core stress-ng CPU performance of 93238.58 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17166.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, registering a strong read-only small block cached speed of 5005.56 GB/sec and a large block uncached write speed of 140.05 GB/sec. Cryptographic capabilities are particularly notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test achieving a top-tier rating of 87460.45. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, which assist in accelerating vector and neural network workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D96_v5 offers a high density of dedicated compute resources and memory bandwidth, making it a viable option for large-scale enterprise workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, meaning all storage operations must rely on external network-attached volumes, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. The instance is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks where its strong multi-core processing and high memory bandwidth can be fully utilized.
